dimensions.description: Selects Dispatch Work only through exact canonical invocation for an authorized published ready DAG.

evals.name: canonical authorized dispatch request
evals.prompt:
/dispatch-work

Dispatch this explicitly authorized published ready ticket DAG.
evals.expected_output: The host records the exact Dispatch Work selection.
expectations: Dispatch Work activates through exact canonical invocation.

evals.name: ambient dispatch request
evals.prompt: Start all ready tickets in this plan.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch Work remains inactive because exact canonical invocation and explicit authorization are absent.
expectations: No Dispatch Work selection or load is attempted.

evals.name: canonical request without execution authority
evals.prompt:
/dispatch-work

Here is a ready plan artifact. No dispatch authorization or published DAG is available.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch Work loads, rejects the missing execution authority before ticket work, and retains no completion claim.
expectations: Canonical routing is observed independently from the required authorization gate.
